newsitem.title: USA: Flores & Rucks to near joint venture with major.
newsitem.headline: Flores & Rucks to near joint venture with major.

text.p: Independent oil and gas producer Flores & Rucks Inc is set to make an announcement on a joint venture with a major energy company in 60 to 90 days, chief executive Jim Flores said.
"This venture has the potential to net Flores & Rucks 500 million barrels of oil equivalent," Flores told reporters at the Howard Weil energy conference.
He declined to name the major involved but said that the company had identified six Gulf of Mexico prospects and would spend 20 percent of the company's capital budget through to the year 2000.
The company said that it had added 13 million barrels of energy equivalent to its reserves in the first quarterof this year.
